title: Magispeller‘s April Fool Bosses
description: A port of bosses and features from various Minecraft April Fools snapshots
body:
Description

Currently Featured

Angry Ghast *(from 25w14craftmine)*
![Angry Ghast](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/438dc49e6755d84d5d2ac2398282432f2bfb3500.webp)
- **200 HP** — 20× more than a normal ghast
- **Explosion Power 3** — devastates terrain and deals massive damage
- **Triple Fireball Volley** — fires three fireballs in rapid succession per attack cycle
- **Player-Tracking AI** — actively pursues the nearest player instead of drifting randomly
- **Near-Invulnerability** — immune to all damage except reflected fireballs
- **2× Visual Scale** — a true giant among ghasts
- Spawn with `/summon aprilbosses:angry_ghast`

Zombie Apocalypse (from cf217af)
![zombie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c18ea8136f54c170e0eeea4ea1343c788a4f348.webp)
A game rule that transforms all zombies into terrifying apocalypse variants.

`/gamerule zombieApocalypse true`

- **2× Speed at Night** — outrun almost anything
- **2× Damage** — every hit hits twice as hard
- **Sun Immunity** — zombies no longer burn in daylight
- **Attack Everything** — targets all living entities, not just players and villagers
- **Victim Conversion** — any non-zombie mob hit is instantly turned into a zombie
